chatgpt.name: ChatGPT
chatgpt.meta: OpenAI · USA · free, or Plus at $20/month (US) Axios, Jan 2026 ↗
secs: Where it lives

Trained
GPT-4 was trained on a Microsoft supercomputer in West Des Moines, Iowa, USA. sourced Associated Press, Sep 2023 ↗

Runs on
Microsoft’s Azure cloud, plus OpenAI’s own “Stargate” sites. The first, in Abilene, Texas, has about 4 of 8 buildings running. Six more are being built in Texas, New Mexico, Wisconsin, Michigan and Ohio. sourced Epoch AI, Apr 2026 ↗

Europe
Stargate Norway in Narvik: hydropower, aiming for 100,000 Nvidia GPUs by the end of 2026. company says OpenAI, Jul 2025 ↗
What it’s made of

Runs on Nvidia GPUs, made mostly by TSMC in Taiwan. These minerals go into them, and are mostly mined here (world share, 2025):

GalliumChina 99% (export controls since 2023)
CopperChile 23% · DR Congo 14% · Peru 12%
TantalumDR Congo 52% · Rwanda 16% · Nigeria 16%
TungstenChina 79%
TinChina 25% · Indonesia 21% · Peru 11%
Rare earthsChina 69% · USA 13%
sourced US Geological Survey, Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 ↗
Who trains it

Kenya
2021–22: OpenAI hired Sama, an outsourcing firm in Nairobi, to label violent and abusive text so ChatGPT could filter it. Workers took home $1.32–2/hour; OpenAI paid Sama $12.50/hour per worker. sourced TIME, Jan 2023 ↗

Philippines
Scale AI’s Remotasks platform: at least 10,000 workers, often paid below the minimum wage, with delayed or cancelled payments. OpenAI was a client. sourced Washington Post, Aug 2023 ↗

Now
OpenAI phased out Scale AI in 2025 and moved more work to Mercor, which hires experts to train advanced models. sourced Fortune, Jun 2025 ↗
Environment

Gas
ChatGPT’s new data centres are mostly powered by gas. Abilene runs on on-site gas plants plus the grid; the Texas and New Mexico sites are planned with their own gas power stations. Only the Wisconsin site says most of its power will be renewable. sourced Epoch AI, Apr 2026 ↗

Water
In July 2022, while GPT-4 was being built there, Microsoft’s Iowa cluster used 43.5 million litres, 6% of the local district’s water, taken from the Raccoon and Des Moines rivers. sourced Associated Press, Sep 2023 ↗

Per chat
OpenAI says one query uses 0.34 Wh and 0.3 ml of water company says Sam Altman, “The Gentle Singularity”, Jun 2025 ↗. Researchers estimate 10–50 ml per response for the older GPT-3 estimate Li, Yang, Islam & Ren, “Making AI Less Thirsty” (UC Riverside / UT Arlington) ↗
Terms and conditions

Training
What you type trains ChatGPT unless you switch it off, on Free, Plus and Pro. Even if you opt out, a thumbs up or down sends that whole conversation for training. company says OpenAI Help Center ↗

Readers
People may read your chats. In Sept 2026, 404 Media revealed hundreds of contractors reading real ChatGPT conversations to rate its answers. Some contained sensitive personal details. sourced 404 Media, Sep 2026 ↗

Ads
Your chats shape the ads you see. Since 2026, Free and Go users get ads based on their conversations, starting in the US. OpenAI says it doesn’t sell your data to advertisers. sourced Axios, Jan 2026 ↗

Deleting
Deleted doesn’t always mean gone. From mid-2025 to 26 Sept 2025, a court order made OpenAI keep chats users had deleted. Normally they’re erased within 30 days. company says OpenAI, Oct 2025 ↗

You can
Switch off Settings → Data controls → Improve the model for everyone, turn off ad personalisation, and use Temporary Chat for anything sensitive.
Politics

EU lobbying
OpenAI declares €500,000–599,999 a year lobbying the EU (2025), mainly on the AI Act, with 76 meetings with senior Commission officials. sourced EU Transparency Register via LobbyFacts ↗
chatgpt.xray:
Dec 2023 to now: The New York Times sued OpenAI and Microsoft for using millions of its articles to train ChatGPT without permission or payment. In March 2025 a judge let the main claims go ahead.

sourced NPR, Mar 2025 ↗

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.meta: Google · USA · free, or paid Google AI plans
secs: Where it lives

Runs on
Google’s own data centres. In Europe: St. Ghislain (Belgium), Fredericia (Denmark), Hamina (Finland), Hanau (Germany), Dublin (Ireland), Eemshaven and Middenmeer (Netherlands), Waltham Cross (UK). In Latin America: Quilicura (Chile) and Canelones (Uruguay). company says Google, data center locations ↗

Chips
Trained and run on Google’s own TPU chips, co-designed with Broadcom and made mainly by TSMC in Taiwan. sourced CNBC, Aug 2024 ↗
What it’s made of

Runs on Google TPUs, made mostly by TSMC in Taiwan. These minerals go into them, and are mostly mined here (world share, 2025):

GalliumChina 99% (export controls since 2023)
CopperChile 23% · DR Congo 14% · Peru 12%
TantalumDR Congo 52% · Rwanda 16% · Nigeria 16%
TungstenChina 79%
TinChina 25% · Indonesia 21% · Peru 11%
Rare earthsChina 69% · USA 13%
sourced US Geological Survey, Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 ↗
Who trains it

Raters
Thousands of contracted “raters” check and correct Gemini’s answers, describing tight deadlines, poor pay and little transparency. sourced The Guardian, Sep 2025 ↗

GlobalLogic
In Sept 2025, more than 200 raters working through the contractor GlobalLogic were fired amid a fight over pay and conditions. Those hired through agencies earned $18–22/hour for the same work as colleagues on $28–32. sourced Wired, Sep 2025 (via Business & Human Rights Resource Centre) ↗
Environment

Water
Google’s water use rose 34% in 2025, to 10.9 billion gallons (about 41 billion litres), more than double 2021. Data centres drove most of the increase. sourced Axios, Jun 2026 ↗

Emissions
Google’s emissions rose 18% in 2025, its biggest annual increase, driven largely by making AI chips and servers. sourced Axios, Jun 2026 ↗

Per prompt
Google says a median Gemini text prompt uses 0.24 Wh and 0.26 ml of water. It excludes images, video and long reasoning tasks. company says MIT Technology Review, Aug 2025 ↗

Uruguay
Google’s data centre plans in Uruguay drew protests during the 2023 drought, when Montevideo was running out of drinking water. sourced Mongabay, Nov 2023 ↗
Terms and conditions

Training
Your Gemini chats train Google’s AI while “Keep Activity” is on. Chats are kept for 18 months by default. company says Google, Gemini Apps Privacy Hub ↗

Readers
Human reviewers read a sample of chats, including people at outside companies. Reviewed chats are kept for up to 3 years, even if you delete your activity. Google warns not to type anything you wouldn’t want a reviewer to see. company says Google, Gemini Apps Privacy Hub ↗

You can
Turn off Keep Activity at myactivity.google.com/product/gemini. Chats are then kept 72 hours and not used for training.
Politics

EU lobbying
Google spends about €4.5 million a year lobbying the EU, and had 35 meetings with senior Commission officials in the first half of 2025. sourced Corporate Europe Observatory & LobbyControl, Oct 2025 (EU Transparency Register data) ↗
gemini.xray:
Project Nimbus: Google and Amazon hold a $1.2 billion cloud and AI contract with the Israeli government. In April 2024, Google fired 28 employees who protested against it.

sourced NBC News, Apr 2024 ↗

Google
Anthropic can also use up to one million Google TPUs, over a gigawatt of capacity by 2026. sourced SiliconANGLE, Oct 2025 ↗

Own sites
Anthropic is building its own data centres in Texas and New York with Fluidstack, coming online through 2026. company says Anthropic, Nov 2025 ↗
What it’s made of

Runs on Amazon Trainium and Google TPU chips, made mostly by TSMC in Taiwan. These minerals go into them, and are mostly mined here (world share, 2025):

GalliumChina 99% (export controls since 2023)
CopperChile 23% · DR Congo 14% · Peru 12%
TantalumDR Congo 52% · Rwanda 16% · Nigeria 16%
TungstenChina 79%
TinChina 25% · Indonesia 21% · Peru 11%

sourced US Geological Survey, Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 ↗
Who trains it

Surge AI
Anthropic used Surge AI, a data-labelling company, for the human feedback that shaped Claude’s answers. Pay rates aren’t public. company says Surge AI case study ↗

Readers
Anthropic confirmed it uses human reviewers on chats from users who allow training. sourced 404 Media, Sep 2026 ↗
Environment

Disclosure
Anthropic doesn’t publish its own energy or water figures.

Water
Near the Indiana site, state officials investigated whether construction water pumping caused neighbours’ wells to run dry. Amazon says the finished site uses cooling water only a few hours a day, April to September. sourced New York Times, Jun 2025 (Weise & Metz) ↗ company says Amazon, Jun 2025 ↗
Terms and conditions

Training
Since Sept 2025, your chats train Claude unless you opt out, on Free, Pro and Max. If you allow it, your data is kept for 5 years instead of 30 days. sourced heise online, Aug 2025 ↗

You can
Switch off model training in Claude’s privacy settings. Work, education and API accounts aren’t used for training.
Politics

EU lobbying
Anthropic declares €200,000–299,999 a year lobbying the EU (2024), mainly on the AI Act, with 22 meetings with senior Commission officials. sourced EU Transparency Register via LobbyFacts ↗
claude.xray:
2026: A judge approved a record $1.5 billion settlement after authors sued Anthropic for training Claude on pirated books: over 400,000 books, about $3,000 each.

sourced JURIST, Jul 2026 ↗

Models
Copilot runs largely on OpenAI’s GPT models, plus Microsoft’s own MAI models. sourced TechCrunch, Jul 2026 ↗

Scale AI
In 2025 Meta bought 49% of Scale AI, the data-labelling company behind the Remotasks platform, for $14.3 billion. sourced SiliconANGLE, Jun 2025 ↗

Contractors
Contractors hired through Alignerr and Scale AI’s Outlier said they could see users’ real names, phone numbers, emails and selfies in Meta AI chats. sourced Business Insider via Fortune, Aug 2025 ↗

Gas

Your posts
Since 27 May 2025, your public Facebook and Instagram posts train Meta’s AI, including older posts, unless you objected. Data already used can’t be removed. sourced Hamburg Data Protection Authority, May 2025 ↗

Your chats
Your conversations with Meta AI are used for training, with no option to object. sourced Hamburg Data Protection Authority, May 2025 ↗

Ads
Outside the EU, UK and South Korea, your Meta AI chats are used to target ads since Dec 2025, with no full opt-out. sourced Tom’s Guide, Oct 2025 ↗

You can
Object in the Facebook and Instagram privacy settings. Each account counts separately unless linked.
Politics

EU lobbying
Meta is the EU’s biggest corporate lobbyist: about €10 million a year, with 27 meetings with senior Commission officials in the first half of 2025. sourced Corporate Europe Observatory & LobbyControl, Oct 2025 (EU Transparency Register data) ↗
meta.xray: Brazil, Oct 2026: Lula’s campaign accused Meta of limiting the reach of his posts to favour Flávio Bolsonaro, citing a network of 255 AI-run Instagram profiles attacking him. The electoral court ordered Meta to explain itself. Meta calls the claims “simply false”; the case is ongoing. sourced bne IntelliNews, Oct 2026 ↗ company says Brazil’s Superior Electoral Court (TSE), Oct 2026 ↗
